capabilities: Sketch plugin screens on phone frames (iPhone, Pixel, Galaxy, or custom sizes)
Save each screen as a small JSON layout file with frames, blocks and theme colours
Arrange items with snapping, anchors and portrait/landscape layouts
Navigate all screens as a tree in a screen map
Hand mockups to coding agents that read and edit the JSON files
disambiguation: Despite the paper-like name, it is not a writing or note-styling tool; it is a visual editor for mockups of app screens.
extras: Installable via BRAT (zelvet-velvet/vellum) or manually from releases; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README is also available in Traditional Chinese.
problem: Designing a mobile plugin or vault app's screens usually means screenshots or prose descriptions that a coding agent cannot turn into accurate layouts.
